test_take: test the idx.take method to retrieve elements from a MultiIndex by positional indexer and verify result equals idx[indexer]
test_take_invalid_kwargs: test the idx.take method raises TypeError for unexpected keyword arguments and ValueError for unsupported out and mode parameters
test_take_fill_value: test the idx.take method with fill_value=True to replace negative indices with NaN/NaT values in a MultiIndex
test_take_allow_fill: test the idx.take method with allow_fill=False to ignore negative indices and return elements without filling in a MultiIndex
test_multiindex_freq_attribute: test that accessing idx.freq on a MultiIndex raises AttributeError since MultiIndex has no freq attribute
